b.fe6cb06dc8:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>D</c>ecember 16th 2026, the 7th day of the Moon,
<h>O</h>n the morrow we keep the feast of the holy martyr Eusebius, Bishop of Vercelli, of whom mention is made upon the 1st day of August, (when he died between the years 370 and 375,) and whose ordination is recorded upon the 15th day of this present month of December.
<h>U</h>pon the same 16th day of December, were born into the better life:
<h>T</h>he three children Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, whose bodies are laid in a certain cave at Babylon (in the sixth century before Christ.)
<h>A</h>t Ravenna, the holy martyrs Valentine, a military instructor, Concordius his son, Navalis, and Agricola, who suffered for Christ's sake, (in the fourth century,) in the persecution under the Emperor Maximian.
<h>A</h>t Nola, in Campania, in the persecution under the Emperor Decius, the holy Virgin and martyr Albina, (in the year 250.)
<h>I</h>n Africa, many holy Virgins and martyrs, who in the Vandal persecution under the Arian king Hunneric suffered hanging, pressing, and redhot plates, and happily brought to a close the conflict of martyrdom, (in the year 482.)
<h>A</h>t Vienne, (in the year 875,) the blessed Confessor Ado, (monk of the Order of St Benedict,) Bishop (of Vienne.)
<h>A</h>t Aberdeen, in Scotland, holy Bean, (called first) Bishop (of that see.)
<h>A</h>t Gaza, in Palestine, (in the year 389,) holy Bishop Irenion.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.
